Management Plan

- Clearly summarize key management actions, treatments, and recommendations provided:
  - Probable tension-type headache vs migraine considered based on unilateral pain and photophobia.
  - First-line analgesia discussed: Ibuprofen recommended as initial treatment; Paracetamol may be continued as well (dose/route/frequency not documented).
  - Lifestyle and stress management: suggested reduced work-related stress; consider taking time off work (self-certify for one week) and exploring counseling options with a self-referral link.
  - Sleep and hydration: aim for 7–8 hours of sleep per night; ensure 1.5–2 liters of fluids daily (water/fluids only, excluding coffee/tea).
  - Follow-up: plan a follow-up in one week; if not improving, blood tests or further investigations may be considered.
